description: This file implements a Thread class for managing thread creation, control, and lifecycle in a cross-platform manner (Windows and POSIX). It includes constructors, destructors, thread start routines, state management, priority control, and platform-specific code for thread handling and naming.

classes.name: Thread
classes.description: A cross-platform abstraction for managing and controlling threads, including their states, priorities, and lifecycle.

methods.name: Thread
methods.description: Constructor to initialize and create a thread with optional custom stack size and name.

methods.name: Signal
methods.description: Sends a signal to the thread, platform-specific.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initialization routine for the thread, default returns true.

methods.name: Terminate
methods.description: Gracefully stops the thread and joins if needed.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Sets the thread state to running.

methods.name: PriorityMin
methods.description: Returns the minimum thread priority for the platform.

methods.name: PriorityMax
methods.description: Returns the maximum thread priority for the platform.

methods.name: Priority
methods.description: Sets the thread priority if supported.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Waits for the thread to reach a specific state within a timeout.

methods.name: State
methods.description: Sets the thread state if the transition is valid.

methods.name: ThreadName
methods.description: Sets the thread name for debugging purposes (Windows-specific).
